data.notes: Current NANPA reporting is the admission authority for in-service geographic NPAs. This bounded pass admits 712 (Iowa), 715 (Wisconsin), and 718 (New York); all satisfy shard B (NPA mod 3 == 1). NANPA planning material confirms 715/534 and the current 347/718/917/929/465 New York overlay; NPA 710 is explicitly reserved for U.S. Government service and is excluded.
